new_entities.name: About 10% weight loss for obstructive sleep apnea
aliases: meaningful lifestyle weight loss for sleep apnea
new_entities.description: Intentional weight loss of roughly 10% body weight through diet and lifestyle intervention in adults with obstructive sleep apnea and overweight or obesity.

new_entities.name: Reduction in apnea-hypopnea index
new_entities.description: A reduction in the apnea-hypopnea index, indicating fewer obstructive breathing events during sleep.

edges.effect_quant: Intentional weight loss generally lowers OSA severity: a 9-study meta-analysis found AHI mean difference -14.3 events/h, Sleep AHEAD showed 9.7 to 7.9 events/h lower AHI through year 4 with a smaller 4.0 events/h difference by year 10, and INTERAPNEA reported a between-group AHI difference of -23.6 events/h after 8 weeks.
edges.population: adults with obstructive sleep apnea plus overweight or obesity, especially those able to sustain clinically meaningful weight loss
edges.mechanism: Weight loss reduces pharyngeal fat loading, lowers upper-airway collapsibility, improves lung volume and ventilatory mechanics, and can reduce the metabolic drivers that worsen obstructive sleep apnea.
edges.summary: This is one of the more reliable non-device ways to improve OSA severity. Benefit scales with the amount of weight loss, but complete normalization is not guaranteed.
edges.caveats: Residual OSA is common even after substantial weight loss. Long-term effects attenuate when weight is regained, and evidence is strongest in overweight or obese adults rather than in lean OSA phenotypes.

evidence.notes: Effects of dietary weight loss on obstructive sleep apnea: a meta-analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: AHI change with dietary weight loss versus control

evidence.citation: KunaST et al 2021 Am J Respir Crit Care Med
evidence.notes: Effects of Weight Loss on Obstructive Sleep Apnea Severity. Ten-Year Results of the Sleep AHEAD Study.

effect_quant.comparator: AHI difference for intensive lifestyle intervention versus diabetes support and education at 10-year polysomnographic follow-up

evidence.citation: Carneiro-BarreraA et al 2022 JAMA Netw Open
evidence.notes: Effect of an Interdisciplinary Weight Loss and Lifestyle Intervention on Obstructive Sleep Apnea Severity: The INTERAPNEA Randomized Clinical Trial.
